description: Fork of Unit Test Skills by Mavka AI, with C# rules and rules added per language on first use.

plugins.name: unit-tests-skills
plugins.description: Generate high-quality unit tests. Analyzes code, prints a Given-When-Then test case list, then writes the tests and verifies they compile and pass. Ships rules for Java (JUnit 5, Mockito, AssertJ) and C# (xUnit, NUnit, MSTest), and drafts rules for another language on first use.
